statements.quote: The excellent soft magnetic properties of HEATFs are a recent discovery; for instance, the Fe22Mn22Co27Cr21Al8 film is characterized by a saturation magnetization (M S) of 80 emu g−1 and coercivity (H C) of 6.3 mT at room temperature (RT); the M S for an electrodeposited CoCuFeNiZn film is 82 emu g−1, whereas the corresponding H C and remanent magnetization (M r) are 19.5 Oe and 1.17%, respectively. statements.attributed: the coercivity increases when the domain wall movement is impeded by the microstructural discontinuities and sharp gradients
statements.quote: The coercivity increases when the domain wall movement is impeded by the microstructural discontinuities and sharp gradients. Therefore, the abundant microcracks in the CoCrFeNithin film would form a discontinuous interface for the magnetic flux, change the magnetic field distribution, and increase the leakage magnetic field above the cracks. Moreover, the microcracks can reinforce the pinning effect of the domain walls.
